description: This file is a React component source file that manages the UI for snapshot viewing and inspection within a trace viewer tool. It includes components for rendering snapshot tabs, snapshot views with iframes, inspectors for DOM elements, and functions for collecting and extending snapshot data.

methods.name: collectSnapshots
methods.description: Collects and returns snapshots (action, before, after) related to a given action, utilizing previous and next actions to infer missing snapshots.

methods.name: extendSnapshot
methods.description: Builds extended snapshot URLs for a given snapshot, including trace parameters and viewports.

methods.name: fetchSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Retrieves snapshot information such as URL and viewport size from a provided snapshot info URL.
